verdict.rationale: The UCP CLI and 'skill' explicitly map natural-language shopper requests (e.g. "find me crewneck sweaters under $50") to structured UCP commands for search, cart, checkout, and order tracking, and this is framed as an assistant-facing capability across catalog/cart/checkout/order MCP tools. However, most of the evidence describes structured CLI/MCP commands and JSON-RPC tool calls rather than a general natural-language interface, and there is no independent/hands-on evidence of NL command robustness beyond the one quickstart example. missing for 10: broader documented examples of natural-language command coverage beyond the single search phrase, independent/hands-on verification of NL-to-command mapping reliability, and NL support for cart/checkout/order operations (not just catalog search).
